programme.title: Geo-Disaster
programme.desc: A family in Los Angeles finds themselves separated during a convergence of history's greatest disasters: a super volcano, a mega earthquake and a massive twister. While the world endures this near apocalyptic event, our heroes must persevere on their own skills and wit to reunite and survive.

programme.title: Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: As night falls in a small California town, the dead rise from their graves. The townspeople must fight to survive until sunrise.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes into the moon and shifts its axis, Earth's gravity pulls the moon into the path of the planet. Now, a group of scientists must figure out how to stop the moon from hitting the earth before it's too late.

For millennia, calendars have added an extra day every four years. In doing so, they violated the ancient Mayan calendar. Now we are in the 13th month of the 13th year of the new millennium, and the few who survive will battle a world of demons.

programme.title: 666: The Child
programme.desc: After a plane crash were a boy is the only survivor, a childless couple adopts him and soon discovers he is something very powerful, something very dark. This small boy is the Beast and with him he carries the Beginning of the End.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.
programme.sub-title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.
programme.sub-title: New Boston Inn & Gloria's House / New Boston Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.
programme.sub-title: Johnson House & Zubrowski House / The Negative Entity

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. The team goes to a home in New Hampshire where the teenage boys are so afraid of the paranormal activity that they want to move. Grant gets attacked by a drum. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El detective Mejía organiza la cacería de Aurelio, en medio de confrontaciones armadas. Casillas muestra su amor y deseo de proteger a su familia, así como su faceta de mujeriego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio resulta herido al salvar a su hija en el atentado, y él y Chacorta logran escapar en una de las camionetas. Escobar le pide a Casillas sacar a su familia de Colombia, pero él no le cumple lo prometido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía captura a Casillas y lo sentencia a pagar por todo lo que ha hecho. Guadalupe le informa a Mónica que arrestaron a Aurelio; ella lo visita en prisión y le pide que se marchen juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Unos presos intentan asesinar a Aurelio, pero él se defiende. Explota una bomba en el carro en el que viajaban Ximena y sus hijos. Casillas sube a un helicóptero para su extradición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe una llamada de Ximena, quien le dice que tanto ella como los niños están bien. Aurelio es liberado y se reúne con su familia; decide casarse y establece una alianza con sus enemigos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo el matrimonio entre Ximena y Aurelio. El Norteño se da cuenta del atentado en contra de la novia, persigue al Jaibo y le informa a Casillas de sus sospechas sobre Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Isidro que sabe que fue él quien mandó poner la bomba en el auto donde viajaban Ximena y los niños. Mónica enfrenta a Casillas, despertando sospechas en su esposa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Guadalupe no cree que la muerte de su hermano Isidro fue un infarto: asegura que Aurelio está involucrado. Casillas les advierte a los suyos que se apoderará del negocio de los colombianos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice al Cabo que viajará con ellos a Colombia, pero Guadalupe y Mónica también llegan para acompañarlos. El coronel Jiménez da órdenes de vigilar a Mejía y a Eugenia, su novia periodista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se ofrece a ayudar a Lupe para rescatar a Mónica, pero él se niega, muy molesto. El Cabo le dice a Casillas que las cosas se complicaron: se preparan para el enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: Blaine finishes his hunt for bears, than heads to the midwest in search of a big buck.

programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Earned Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: A packed episode with 3 hunts from the Hayworth Family with some wild footage of BIG Whitetails.

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: Join me as I head deep into Wyoming's backcountry with my dad and young mules in pursuit of mule deer. After two years of training, they're ready to carry the load. This hunt is more than just filling a tag-it's about partnership, tradition.
programme.sub-title: Mulies, Mules and Memories: A Wyoming Hunting Journey

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: Brooke is on the search for her buck and gets closer with the other contestants as they take a lot of their time to help track down her buck. A new Accubow challenge allows the girls to compete for a new hunting spot called Public Land.

programme.title: Yamaha Adventure Flim Series
programme.desc: From the rugged red walls of the Grand Canyon to the icy expanse of Alaska, the Yamaha Wolverine lineup proves its place as the ultimate adventure machine. In this all-in-one journey, we put the 2025 RMAX4 1000 and its Real World Tough accessories.
programme.sub-title: Across America: Yamaha RMAX 1000 Conquers the West

programme.title: Own The Season Tv
programme.desc: Art and Michelle chase Wisconsin Turkeys. Art takes his archery equipment while Michelle sticks with her tried and trusted 12ga.
Follow Adam Hays as he hunts for his 5th 200 inch whitetail in his home state of Ohio.

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: 17 youth episodes and counting. Let's watch the youngsters get it done!

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: The Bearded Buck crew gears up for their annual turkey event they host every year right on their home farm in PA.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Not necessarily a tree stand, but it is made of wood, Matt has the idea to hunt off of a scarecrow pole. Sitting in the middle of a food plot, Matt gets up close and personal with deer in this episode.

programme.title: Cabela's Deer Gear
programme.desc: Feeding Programs for Attracting Wildlife.

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: Terry heads to Mexico for his annual White Winged Dove hunt with Steve McCain of Wide Open Outfitters.
If you hunt big whitetails, this is a must see!

programme.title: Dream Makers
programme.desc: We join a recipient named Gabe and his family as they blast Canada geese out of the sky up in North Dakota! Then we meet up with a young man named Charlie and his parents as he makes a 300-yard shot on a pronghorn antelope!

programme.title: Man vs. Elk
programme.desc: We go after bull elk during the rut with a bow in Colorado.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: Steve explains the benefits of having less resources while figuring out the key to still maximizing your fun in the deer woods.

programme.title: McWhorters Precision Hunting
programme.desc: Allan hunts Panther Hollow Whitetails in South Texas for a couple giant bucks.

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: For 23 years John has worked as a government trapper, wildlife biologist and district supervisor in the Federal Wildlife Services Program. Many of those years involved trapping year-round to resolve coyote and beaver damage to livestock.
programme.sub-title: John and Mark on Multi Line 1 of 2

programme.title: Hitmen
programme.desc: We are in Canada chasing black bears. This week we have Eddie looking for a big bear. Dave is working on his first black bear and first bow harvest. At the end we have a little clip of Matthew harvesting his first buck with a Zeus!

programme.title: Mass Pursuit Tv
programme.desc: Keith Heads to the Buckeye Valley Ranch for the Monster Action.

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: A major storm brings cleanup work and a pause in deer season. Back in Kentucky, the struggle is real with tough hunts and injuries, while Cadyn gives it her all during an Alabama trip.

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: The TRE crew drags the famous couch back to the field for dove season-this time, it's our turn to pull the trigger instead of guiding. When the barrels get hot the dove don't stand a chance. And when the sky fills with pigeons.

programme.title: Hank Parker's Outdoor Magazine
programme.desc: On this episode of Hank Parker's Outdoor Magazine Hank And Wally Marshall AKA Mr crappie Head south to the St. Johns river in hopes of catching crappie.

programme.title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors
programme.desc: Jimmy is walking and calling Turkeys. Big Tom comes in quick.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: James and his good friend Brian Smith chase antelope in Montana.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The fifth episode of Wild Shots Season 1 is here!

programme.title: Hunttech Pro - African Series
programme.desc: Join us as we continue our unforgettable hunting adventure at Ikamela Safaris in the Free State, South Africa!
programme.sub-title: Double Dream Hunt! Fallow Deer, Zebra & More at Ikamela Safaris!

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV
programme.desc: This week on Shoot Straight Chad has pronghorn tags for New Mexico and Wyoming. Marsha will be making a delicious Recipe from the Field.

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv
programme.desc: A: Grip Nuances B: Transitions/Mantis Acadamy C: Lever Action RIA D: External Ballistics.

programme.title: Paid Programming
programme.desc: Paid programming.

programme.title: North American Trapper
programme.desc: Alan travels back to his childhood home showing where he got his start in trapping.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: THIS WEEK WE ARE IN BEAUTIFUL BIG PINE KEY IN THE LOWER FLORIDA KEYS. BIG PINE KEY IS ONE OF THE MOST CHARMING AND UNIQUE SPOTS IN THE FLORIDA KEYS, AND IT'S GOT A VIBE THAT REALLY SETS IT APART FROM OTHER ISLANDS IN THE REGION.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: We're joined by Worship Leader, Rob Key. A musical talent that's chased the country music dream, but found his calling as worship leader at Taylorsville Community Church; Rob's love for serving the Lord is his top priority but he also likes fishing.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Part one of Rochelles Multi-year hunt with her Excalibur crossbow for the Flyer buck.

programme.title: Fisherman's Digest
programme.desc: John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.

programme.title: Yamaha Adventure Flim Series
programme.desc: From conquering the unforgiving granite of the Rubicon Trail to battling the mud and chaos of the Ironman GNCC, Yamaha's Proven Off-Road machines show what they're made of. The RMAX 1000 traverses one of the most rugged trails in North America.
programme.sub-title: Trail Tested, Race Proven: Wolverine RMAX 1000 & YFZ450R in Action

programme.title: Live the Wild Life
programme.desc: Follow Gus as we take a look at hunting whitetail deer in the northeast USA.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Join host Joe Eppele on a thrilling trip to Haida Gwaii in pursuit of his first Sitka Blacktail deer. Enjoy family fun fishing and nonstop action on a hunt in the heart of Haida Gwaii with Sandspit Adventures.

programme.title: Chasin The Sun

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Illustrating scientific debates over the rise of humans; the ancestry casts Ramapithecus out; witnessing fossil evidence and molecular evidence, working both together and independently; explaining some of anthropology's most complex issues.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Discovering and debating over fossil remains of a possible Homo ancestor, Australopithecus afarensis, in 1970; following the story from the perspective of the key personalities involved, scientists Don Johanson and Richard Leakey.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Discovering the 4.4-million-year-old remains of Ardipithecus ramidus; debating whether it is a true hominin or not; suggesting a mix between an effective climber and walking bipedally; examining the fossil and genetic evidence of this "ground ape."

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: A human's brain separates them more from apes than any other anatomical feature; investigating the gradual increase in hominid brain size; fossil skulls revealing facts about blood circulation; shedding light on brain size and skull structure.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Exploring the link between diet and morphology in Australopithecus robustus and Africanus; the teeth and jaws of these two species offer fierce debates about dietary hypotheses; adaptive differences between robust and gracile hominids.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Wondering whether Africa or Asia is closer to human origins; drawing on the ideas and theories of prominent scientists like Charles Darwin, Ernst Haeckel and Louis Leakey; learning how scientists trace the origin and evolution of the genus Homo.

programme.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates
programme.desc: Tools mark a major step in evolution, but even chimpanzees can make and use tools; Professor Martin offers a detailed picture of early stone toolmakers; illustrating some of the primitive tools found in parts of Africa.
programme.sub-title: An Ape's View of the Oldowan

programme.desc: Fossil records reveal that Homo habilis serves as a transitional marker between Australopithecines and the rest of the genus Homo; Homo habilis has the anatomy to be ancestors of the genus Homo yet not exist at the right time in evolutionary history.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Taking a trip through the universal timeline from the big bang to a future of ever-accelerating expansion; the eight key stages between them include the condensation of atoms, the birth of the first stars and the formation of galaxies.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Astronomers overlap techniques of "distance ladder" to determine distances in the universe; triangulation works for nearby stars; observers use pulsating stars for farther objects, the rotation of galaxies and a class of supernova explosions.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Measuring the Doppler shift of galaxies in the early 20th century; observations reveal that they all were moving away from Earth; the more distant ones move faster, proportional to distance; this is the Hubble Law, implying the initial "big bang."

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Professor Whittle defines distances in cosmology; the three important distances to consider is the emission distance when the light is set out; the current distance, when the light arrives; the distance the light travels.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: If war is a gamble, then a strategy is key to success; a survey of why strategy is important; looking at World War II's "Operation Torch" as a case study for how the military should be used as an instrument of policy.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: A systematic look at what makes Thucydides perhaps history's first great strategist; his analysis of the Peloponnesian War; the political origins of the war; the Spartan and Athenian leadership; the social and moral implications of war.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Joining a debate over the efficacy of the Sicilian Expedition; turning to the Melian Dialogue; the debate between realists and neoconservatives over the conduct of war; considering how this debate still plays out in contemporary America.
programme.sub-title: Thucydides as a Possession for All Time

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Sun Tzu's writing is popular in the modern world; the historical context for "Master Sun's Military Methods"; an overview of Sun Tzu's strategy for war, which is to be efficient, avoid protracted wars and value the commander's intellect and skill.
programme.sub-title: Sun Tzu's the Art of War

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Charting Sun Tzu's historical importance throughout Chinese history, in feudal and modern Japan, and in the modern West; learning Sun Tzu's strategy of deception in action by exploring Operation Fortitude in the Allied invasion of Normandy.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Learning about Machiavelli, the Italian Renaissance man who writes his own "The Art of War" in which he advocates a citizen-army; going through Machiavelli's book of tactics, which is his recommendation for Florentine military rulers.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Discovering fortuna, which is Machiavelli's philosophy of circumstances, and virtu, which is his recipe for military action; the strategies Machiavelli thinks a republican military should adopt; the qualities to look for in a good commander.

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers
programme.desc: Experiencing the battles of Jena and Auerstedt during the Napoleonic Wars; these two decisive victories demonstrate the radical transformation of warfare; they give rise to Antoine-Henri Jomini and Carl von Clausewitz, two important masters of war.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan.
programme.sub-title: Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups.

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR.
programme.sub-title: From World War to Cold War

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: In Franklin's unfinished autobiography, he creates a persona for himself as a role model others may follow; there is more to Franklin than he shows on the page; surveying the book offers some foundational insights into his life and his worldview.
programme.sub-title: Benjamin Franklin and the American Dream

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: The Franklins are a typical 18th-century family, extended across space; filled with comedy and tragedy, wealth and poverty; meeting his parents and siblings; learning the story of his wife and first-born son; accompanying Franklin on his travels.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: One may associate Franklin with Philadelphia, but his roots lie in Boston; many of the virtues Franklin cultivates throughout his life grow from the values of the Boston Puritans; witnessing the events that Franklin experiences in his youth.

programme.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin
programme.desc: Shifting attention to the City of Brotherly Love; 18th-century Philadelphia is one of the leading cities in British America; it is one of the leading cities in the British Empire; what makes this city so important; how the city shapes Franklin.

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.desc: Why the United States created a secret foreign intelligence service; examining three periods of U.S. government intelligence before the birth of the CIA; the American Revolution to the late 1930s; World War II; the postwar years from 1945 to 1947.
programme.sub-title: Secrecy, Democracy, and the Birth of the CIA

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.desc: How the CIA transformed from an intelligence agency to housing the United States' premier covert-action unit in the space of just two years; the role of George F. Kennan, who declared political warfare against the Soviet Union.
programme.sub-title: George Kennan and the Rise of Covert Ops

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.desc: The CIA's attention to Asia; how the CIA failed to rein in its emphasis on covert operations and restore its focus on intelligence; a lack of public scrutiny of the CIA's actions; the arrival of future CIA director Allen Dulles.
programme.sub-title: The CIA, China, and the Korean War

programme.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA
programme.desc: The 1953 Iran Coup and how it created a culture of covert action that would shape the CIA's future; studying the shifting political attitudes toward Iranian nationalism; analyzing the Iran operation; pondering who was most responsible.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.
programme.sub-title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: From 1830 to 1890, the lives of the Plains Indians change irrevocably; the early history of the Plains Indians; the importance of buffalo and horses to life on the Great Plains; two visitors' perspectives on America's treatment of the Plains Indians.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: The story behind the last stand at the Alamo; the tale of the Texas republic; what leads to tensions between the Mexican government and the United States; why the idea of rebellion is crucial to the myth of Texas; how the territory joins the U.S.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Exploring the significance of battlefields and the methods employed by soldiers in combat.
programme.sub-title: The Power of Place: The Civil War in Context

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Marching from Washington, Irvin McDowell's Union forces encounter P. G. T. Beauregard's Confederate troops at Virginia's Bull Run.
programme.sub-title: Manassas: The First Battle of Bull Run

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Stonewall Jackson fights in the Shenandoah Valley; Joseph E. Johnston attacks McClellan at Seven Pines or Fair Oaks; in the Seven Days' Battles, Robert E. Lee seizes the initiative and presses the Federals south to the James; Lee saves Richmond.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: In the Second Battle of Bull Run, lieutenants James Longstreet and Thomas Stonewall Jackson play a crucial role in securing victory for Robert E. Lee.
programme.sub-title: A Return to Manassas: The Second Battle of Bull Run

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
programme.desc: After finding a laptop, a young man goes online to play a game with five of his good friends. He shows them a mysterious folder that plays disturbing videos of people who appear to be in danger. They then receive an anonymous message that tells them they will all die if they disconnect or call the police. The planned night of fun quickly turns deadly as each user becomes the target of something sinister while the others watch helplessly in terror.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notices curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parents (James Brolin) is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett (John Marley), is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren (Kathleen Lloyd), are endangered.

programme.title: You'll Like My Mother
programme.desc: When her husband is killed in Vietnam, Francesca Kinsolving (Patty Duke) finds herself pregnant and alone. She resolves to visit her in-laws in Minnesota, believing, based on her late husband's assurances, that she'll be welcomed there. Instead, she finds Mrs. Kinsolving (Rosemary Murphy) a dreadful curmudgeon who won't even admit that her son married. Shaken but not scared off, Francesca sticks around and discovers she may be entitled to the family fortune.

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: A paroled ex-police detective (Burt Lancaster) works as campus night watchman and solves a coed's murder.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster), however Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.desc: An entomologist (Angie Everhart) accompanies a team of commandos to prevent prehistoric insects from escaping from a subway system.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Raised by her father (Eric Bana) in the Finnish wilderness, teenage Hanna (Saoirse Ronan) has trained all her life to be the perfect assassin. Her father sends her on a mission, and she stealthily makes her way across Europe while evading agents sent after her by a ruthless operative named Marissa (Cate Blanchett), who once worked with Hanna's father. As she draws closer to her target, Hanna faces startling revelations about her existence and begins to question her humanity.

programme.title: Black Forest
programme.desc: Tourists are lured into a deadly game in an alternate world where every fairy-tale creature from stories is real.

programme.title: Threshold
programme.desc: While on a routine spacewalk, an astronaut unwittingly becomes host to an alien parasite. After he returns to Earth, the eggs hatch from his body, and the moth-like creatures that emerge begin terrorizing Houston. NASA scientist Jerome "Geronimo" Horne (Nicholas Lea) and entomologist Dr. Savannah Bailey (Jamie Luner) struggle to contain the rapidly spreading alien infestation, as world powers threaten to take matters into their own hands and destroy the city with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome
programme.desc: A routine mission becomes dangerous when two pilots escort a mysterious woman.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.desc: A grieving woman embarks on a path of self-destruction after the accidental death of her beloved husband. Soon, a chance encounter with a guitar-toting stranger inspires her to regain her faith and unite her family once again.

programme.title: Play the Flute
programme.desc: A new youth pastor tries to motivate his students to read the words of the Lord.

programme.title: Heaven Sent
programme.desc: Elise, a grandmother hurt by her past, and Patrick, a widowed pastor, have closed the door on love. But with faith and a little help from technology, their live-streamed romance might find a way.

programme.title: 77 Chances
programme.desc: An aspiring photographer (Andrew Cheney) magically lives the same day over and over again.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: John Wright was a hometown hero - the powerful star of his high school wrestling team and a promising Olympian. However, one bad decision destroyed his dreams and forced him to leave under a cloud of scandal that has haunted him ever since.

programme.title: The Ultimate Legacy
programme.desc: Jason Stevens continues his journey while helping a friend walk a similar path.

programme.title: Extraordinary
programme.desc: Following open-heart surgery, a marathon runner believes he has to hang up his running shoes for good. Instead, he feels called upon by God to inspire people one last time and sets off on a 2,900-mile race across America.

programme.title: Because of Grácia
programme.desc: Chase Morgan would love to live up to his own name and pursue something great. It's his senior year, and he's still as insecure as ever, but Eastglenn High's newest student is about to turn that around. Grácia is a girl with charisma, intelligence and conviction, but she's not as put together as Chase and his best friend O.B. might think. A dark past gives her a unique connection with Bobbi, a misunderstood classmate who has a pushy boyfriend and disconnected father.

programme.title: Love on the Rock
programme.desc: Retirement gets put on hold when a tough, burned-out former cop finds himself catapulted into a web of high-stakes international espionage.

programme.title: Programming Will Return at 6 AM EST
programme.desc: Programming will return at 6 AM Eastern Standard Time (5 AM CST).

programme.title: Wedding Screeners
programme.desc: When a late wife's last wish is for her husband to remarry, his daughters insist on prescreening potential candidates, soon realizing that happiness might not be as simple as checking all the boxes.

programme.title: Finding Love in Quarantine
programme.desc: Forced into quarantine, single father Rick Baldwin tries to keep his sanity while searching for love online.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Dirt track racer Sean Weathers (Andrew Cheney) was at the top of his game with an unstoppable career. When a rivalry with another racer turns personal, the ego that propelled him to success causes a tragedy, sending his life into a tailspin. Jack Reed (Gary Graham) had prospered as a businessman but failed as a family man. In a sudden turn of events, his chances for reconciliation are ripped from his grasp. Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

programme.title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
programme.desc: When young Sara hears a preacher say faith can move mountains, she starts praying. Suddenly, people in her town are mysteriously healed -- but fame soon takes its toll.

programme.title: The Reason
programme.desc: A mysterious man brings hope to a small-town pastor, his wife and their sick child.

programme.title: The Abigail Mysteries
programme.desc: Struggling to come to terms with loss, Abby Brooks goes on a journey of faith, reconnection and adventure as she works with a local cop and childhood crush, Matt, to solve a mystery.

programme.title: God's Country Song
programme.desc: A charming but troubled country singer learns he has a 5-year-old son that he didn't know existed. Struggling with alcohol addiction, he must now decide whether to raise the boy or leave his family behind to pursue his dream of musical stardom.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein (Basil Rathbone) is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor (Bela Lugosi), a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster (Boris Karloff) his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notices curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot (Kurt Russell) and the camp doctor (Richard Dysart) lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon (Henry Hull) is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami (Warner Oland), who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald (Ethan Hawke) is in a slump; he hasn't had a best seller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: When five college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison, Fran Kranz, Jesse Williams) arrive at a remote forest cabin for a little vacation, little do they expect the horrors that await them. One by one, the youths fall victim to backwoods zombies, but there is another factor at play. Two scientists (Richard Jenkins, Bradley Whitford) are manipulating the ghoulish goings-on, but even as the body count rises, there is yet more at work than meets the eye.

programme.desc: Un espacio de reportajes, entrevistas y análisis en donde se discuten los temas políticos, científicos, culturales y de salud que interesan y preocupan a los hispanos residentes en Los Ángeles y el estado de California. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: El Yaqui
programme.desc: Abandonan a un niño yaqui en un pueblo donde sus mayores fueron engañados para ser reclutados al ejército federal. Una prostituta se retira de su oficio para rescatar al menor y cuidarlo.

programme.title: El hijo de Gabino Barrera
programme.desc: El hijo de Gabino Barrera quiere vengar la muerte de su padre y tiene el apoyo de los campesinos, pero se enamora de la hija del presunto asesino, quien al confesar, desata un enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El Embustero
programme.desc: Un ladrón, huyendo de la policía, se va a un pueblo donde lo confunden con el profesor de escuela que todos esperaban.

programme.title: Palenque
programme.desc: Un hombre obsesionado con un hijo varón tiene una hija y la cría en la rudeza del campo, los caballos y los palenques.

programme.title: La Revancha: Palenque II
programme.desc: Una poderosa hacendada se enfrenta a un grupo de pistoleros que se quieren adueñar de su palenque y de sus tierras.

programme.title: El caballo del diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre malvado se viste de negro y monta su caballo del mismo color, para realizar cosas abominables e ilegales.

programme.title: El Fantástico Mundo de los Hippies
programme.desc: Un agente del FBI se infiltra en el mundo de los hippies en su búsqueda de una joven desaparecida.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Dimas de León
programme.desc: Acosada por injustificados celos, una mujer planea una trampa para traicionar a un hombre valiente.

programme.title: El Tesoro de Atahualpa
programme.desc: Un avión mexicano se estrella en la selva peruana, y se envía a una expedición para que rescate a los sobrevivientes.

programme.title: Zacazonapan
programme.desc: Tres amigos tratan de ganarse el amor de las mujeres más bellas del pueblo, cuando lo logran ocurren tres bodas.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: Que te Vaya Bonito
programme.desc: Miguel Fernández es un cantante y compositor, también un alcohólico rehabilitado, se casa con Torcasa, pero le es infiel con Lupita. Cuando su esposa se entera, se suicida y la amante lo deja.

programme.title: Lanza tus penas al viento
programme.desc: Un hombre emigra a la capital donde conoce a una mujer y se enamora, pero descubre que ella tiene una enfermedad mortal.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Juliancito
programme.desc: Juliancito y su amigo están hartos del trato de sus papás, por lo que deciden irse a vivir a una isla y hacer creer a sus familias que están muertos para darles una lección.

programme.title: Lucio Vázquez: El Crimen en Chinameca
programme.desc: Lucio intenta evitar más muertes, frustrado quiere venganza, pero su novia se lo impide. Al final, pierde a su líder, Emiliano Zapata, a su padre y también a Evangelina, la mujer que ama.

programme.title: La Mafia Tiembla II
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante es apresado y recibe la visita de un amigo con quien recuerda las injusticias que pasó al ser ilegal.

programme.title: Tirano Banderas
programme.desc: El dictador indígena Santos Banderas tiene una sola debilidad: su única y hermosa hija.

programme.title: El último desafío
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante escapa de la custodia del FBI y huye a México, pero en su camino hacia la libertad se interpondrá el policía de un pequeño pueblo fronterizo.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria
programme.desc: Un hombre decide que es hora de que sus dos hijos se casen. Para eso, acude a su compadre, que tiene dos bellas hijas.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, el es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero éste vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: El Fantástico Mundo de los Hippies
programme.desc: Un agente del FBI se infiltra en el mundo de los hippies en su búsqueda de una joven desaparecida.

programme.title: Tres veces mojado
programme.desc: Los terribles problemas que enfrenta un inmigrante ilegal al salir de su hogar en El Salvador y entrar a los EE.UU.

programme.title: Nido de águilas
programme.desc: Los hermanos Menchaca, despojados de su hogar, buscan a la pandilla del Tigre responsables del asesinato de sus padres.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Offshore oil drilling and the rescue of fishermen who claim there is a dangerous creature in the bay occupy the lifeguards.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Offshore oil drilling and the rescue of fishermen who claim there is a dangerous creature in the bay occupy the lifeguards.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Megan narrowly escapes an attacker on the beach, who then stalks her; lifeguard Shauni suffers from burnout.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A movie producer offers Mitch a part in an action film; Shauni raises money for an animal-rescue group.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch's rebellious nephew (Chance M. Corbitt) risks his life surfing in dangerous waters near a condemned pier. With David Hasselhoff.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A gang member (Richard Coca) defies his father (Danny Trejo) and joins a program where he learns various aquatic skills. With Billy Warlock, John Allen Nelson.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Hobie helps his new friend, a homeless girl, retrieve an important item stolen from her by a vagrant.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: When Shauni decides that she and Eddie should take a break from their romance, Eddie makes a date with a woman he has never seen before.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A teenage girl tries to impress her peers by claiming Eddie seduced her; a former lifeguard prone to daredevil adventures gets Hobie into trouble.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch suspends Eddie because of the rape charges against him; Eric Turner has an accident while hang gliding.

programme.title: Baywatch
